interpretation.plain_speak: The dangerous moment is the transition into persistent fragility, not simply staying fragile for longer. In a fresh phase, examples entering streak 2 flipped about 28.4% of the time versus 13.5% once fragility was already established. STORE and OBSERVE reproduced the effect; REPORT did not.
interpretation.north_star_question: Strengthens internal self-detection by showing that temporal state carries hazard information across phases, while leaving open whether that information adds predictive value beyond static low-rank margin alone.
interpretation.next_stage: hold static vulnerability rank strata fixed and test whether transition-to-persistent remains more predictive than current-only or established persistence within the same rank bands
